CMS.// Hosting: On App Service /home is a network share, and Lucene writing its segments there is what corrupted the Examine indexes twice (missing _25r.si: every Management API write answered 500, the agent runs failed). The two settings below are Umbraco's own recommendation for Azure Web Apps: the indexes are written on the instance's local disk and only copied to /home, so they survive a restart without a rebuild and a restart never catches Lucene mid-write.
